summary: Mixed night: oil plunged 7.7% on US-Iran deal hopes and lifted the Dow, but renewed AI/chip selling sank the Nasdaq-100 1.3% while Fed officials keep a December hike in play. US midterms Tuesday and the RBA decision today add event risk.
events_next_24h: Tue 2:30pm AUD RBA rate decision (hike expected)
Tue all day USD US midterm elections (results from Wed morning Sydney)

ES.why: S&P gave up a 1.1% morning gain to close -0.5% as AI selling and Fed hike talk outweighed the oil drop; fund positioning is neutral.
ES.risk: US midterms Tuesday or an oil-led broad rally lifting the 493 non-tech stocks.

NQ.why: Nasdaq-100 fell 1.3% on renewed AI/chip selling while Fed's Logan wants more hikes; funds are crowded long (94th pct), fuel for more downside.
NQ.risk: Apple/AMD earnings reviving AI buying or a midterm relief rally squeezing shorts.

YM.why: Dow rose 0.4% as the 7.7% oil plunge helped old-economy stocks, but hawkish Fed talk caps it; mixed.
YM.risk: Clear oil direction from a US-Iran deal or collapse would pick a side.

RTY.why: Small caps slipped 0.2%; lower oil helps but Fed hike odds (~70% for Dec) hurt rate-sensitive small firms.
RTY.risk: A sharp move in yields after the midterms.

NKD.why: Japan cash market shut for Culture Day; US chip selloff weighs but a weak yen near 158 supports exporters, and funds lean short.
NKD.risk: US tech direction overnight and any yen intervention.

6E.why: Euro firmed 0.3% on a mixed dollar, but a hawkish Fed supports the dollar; no clear edge.
6E.risk: Fed speakers adding to hike odds would weigh on the euro.

6J.why: Dollar/yen up to 157.9 as the Fed talks hikes and the BOJ held at 1.25%, keeping the yield gap wide; a lean only.
6J.risk: Japan intervention near 158-160 could spike the yen sharply.

6B.why: Pound edged up 0.1% on a mixed dollar; no fresh UK driver overnight.
6B.risk: Hawkish Fed repricing lifting the dollar broadly.

6A.why: Aussie fell 0.5% into today's RBA decision, where a hike is expected; the outcome could swing it either way.
6A.risk: RBA hike plus hawkish guidance (up) or a hold (down).

ZN.why: Long yields fell ~3bp as oil plunged, but 2-year held and Fed officials want more hikes; the two forces conflict.
ZN.risk: A US-Iran deal pushing oil lower still, or more hike talk from Fed speakers.

GC.why: Gold rebounded 1.7% from 1-year lows as long yields fell; funds lean short (24th pct), leaving room to buy back.
GC.risk: Hawkish Fed repricing pushing real yields and the dollar higher.

CL.why: WTI plunged 7.7% to about $96 on US-Iran deal hopes to reopen Hormuz; funds already lean short (13th pct), so a lean only.
CL.risk: Washington rejecting Iran's conditional offer or new Hormuz tanker attacks.
